properties.notes: The LDF has been superseded by the new Local Plan which was adopted 27 July 2020 and therefore any new application will be determined against the new policies of the Local Plan.. Former NYCC Depot, West Ayton (previous outline planning consent for open market housing development with planning brief, now lapsed.) Site straddles the National Park boundary and being split between the National Park and Scarborough Borough Council. 10 open market dwellings in total on the whole site, two and three bedroomed dwellings. 40% affordable housing requirement under Core policy J of the LDF. Development to take account of planning brief and more recent Conservation Area status. Development will require the retention of the Station House/office, platform and Goods Warehouse.
